## render

```ts
export function render(
  ui: React.ReactNode,
  options?: ComponentRenderOptions,
): Promise<RenderResult>
```

The `render` function records a `react.render` trace mark, visible in the [Trace View](/guide/browser/trace-view).

:::warning
Note that `render` is asynchronous, unlike in other packages. This is to support [`Suspense`](https://react.dev/reference/react/Suspense) correctly.

```tsx
import { render } from 'vitest-browser-react'
const screen = render(<Component />) // [!code --]
const screen = await render(<Component />) // [!code ++]
```

:::

## render

```ts
export function render<C extends Component>(
  Component: ComponentImport<C>,
  options?: ComponentOptions<C>,
  renderOptions?: SetupOptions
): Promise<RenderResult<C>>
```

The `render` function records a `svelte.render` trace mark, visible in the [Trace View](/guide/browser/trace-view).

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
